title: Action sought against author during Hubballi protest over remarks on Basavanna

ai.summary: Protesters in Hubballi condemned author Ravi Hanj's remarks about 12th century social reformer Basavanna, demanding legal action under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and IT Act.

facts.claim: protesters condemned Ravi Hanj's remarks about Basavanna
facts.quote: Members of various people’s organisations staged a protest in Hubballi on Thursday, condemning the derogatory remarks about 12th century social reformer Basavanna and statement concerning the Constitution.

facts.claim: protesters demanded legal action against Ravi Hanj under Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and IT Act
facts.quote: They demanded registration of a case against Mr. Hanj under the relevant provisions of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and the Information Technology Act.
